source_split: Fold D development, 21 sources; not a held-out final test set
input_policy: Read only partial array from frozen NPZ; same defective-bbox normalization across arms. No labels/GT, sampling, augmentation, alignment or output correction.
native_policy: Same frozen prefix.build_model constructor and seeds as training; strict load correctly arm-tagged epoch99/step3900 checkpoint; eval plus inference_mode; exactly one full forward per case. No training-worker import or loss attachment.
outputs: 315 prediction NPZs with native coarse/dense and existing OASG S/delta/parent-index diagnostics; paired manifest, attempt journal, state/RNG evidence, resource records and checksum archive
state_policy: Within each arm, require parameter/buffer and four RNG fingerprints unchanged over 105 eval forwards. Trained parameters are not required to match across arms.
